system.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a
creature within Far range. Ona
success, spend a Hope to hijack the
target’s muscles, cyberware, nervous
system, pain response, or nervous
system for a brief violent burst.
You can cause the target to move,
attack, or both. If you do both, you
choose the order.
lf you cause the creature to move, they
move to a location you choose within
Close range of them.
lf you cause the creature to attack,
make an Interface Roll against a target
within Melee range of them.
On a success, deal d10 physical
damage using your Proficiency.
